changes: Gate IV reload advice to IV route
Require formulation when missed-dose history is entered without route
Suppress IV numerical calculation for SC and state fixed-dose alternative
Add SC-specific missed-dose advice; no loading dose
limitations: SC remains a pharmacy-verified prescription in this proposal; no generic numeric override is introduced into the shared dose engine.
No new ANC, DPD, renal, hepatic or ILD threshold is proposed.
